name: Whirlpool W11296289 SxS Cabinet Thermistor
purpose: W11296289 service matrix — 2.7 kΩ @ 25°C for FC, RC, and defrost thermistors. Service mode LED open/short/pass on steps 1, 3, 5.
failureModes: Open — THESEUS LED6+7 on; ATHENA D7/D8/D9 fail pattern
In range but warm cabinet — damper (step 9) or sealed system
testingTips: THESEUS: P5 RC (GY), P5 FC (TN), P8 defrost (PK) — 5 VDC input circuits
Measure at harness with power disconnected for bench ohms

name: Whirlpool W11296289 SxS Defrost Heater
purpose: 550–650 Ω @ 115 VAC (all cu ft). Service step 13 energizes heater; THESEUS P2-7 or ATHENA JP1-2/6 when defrosting.
failureModes: Open — no defrost; heavy evap frost
Good ohms but no heat in step 13 — ACU relay or thermal fuse
testingTips: Verify 120 VAC at P2-7 (THESEUS) or JP1-2/6 (ATHENA) during step 13

name: Whirlpool W11296289 SxS Evaporator Fan Motor
purpose: Evaporator fan 2–9 Ω. Service step 15 commands fan on; THESEUS P2-6 outputs 120 VAC when cooling.
failureModes: Open winding — fan silent in step 15
testingTips: Service step 15: verify fan runs and airflow at evaporator
Check P2-6 ↔ P1-2 for 120 VAC when fan commanded

name: Whirlpool W11296289 SxS Condenser Fan Motor
purpose: Condenser fan 3–12 Ω. Service step 7 turns on compressor/condenser fan path.
failureModes: Open — condenser fan does not run with compressor in step 7
testingTips: Step 7 monitors cond fan with compressor circuit
Verify condenser coil clean before condemning fan

name: Whirlpool W11296289 SxS Compressor Run Windings
purpose: EGX60HLC / EM3Y60HLP run windings 1–5 Ω. Service step 7 energizes compressor/cond fan.
failureModes: Open winding — compressor silent; relay may click
Good ohms but no run — start device/overload or sealed system
testingTips: EGX60HLC 102 W / EM3Y60HLP 109 W per cu ft matrix

name: Whirlpool W11296289 SxS 120 VAC Load Output
purpose: 120 VAC at THESEUS P1/P2/P3 or ATHENA JP1 when load commanded (compressor, defrost, evap fan, water valve).
failureModes: No voltage with load commanded — ACU relay or harness
Low voltage — supply cord, outlet, or thermal fuse
testingTips: THESEUS: P1-1/2 input constant; P1-2/4 compressor; P2-7 defrost; P2-6 evap fan
ATHENA: JP1-3/6 input; JP1-4/6 compressor+fans; JP1-2/6 defrost
